segments.text: Most people meet a restoration contractor once, on the worst day of their year.
So here is what the work actually is.
Restoration is returning your property to the condition it was in before the loss. Not repairing it. Not renovating it. Returning it.
First the damage is stopped. Water extracted, power made safe, the affected area contained.
Then the property is dried and monitored, because what you cannot see is what decides whether mould arrives in six weeks.
Then whatever cannot be saved is removed, and whatever can be saved is restored.
Only then does any rebuilding start.
Every stage is documented, because your insurer will ask, and because you are entitled to see it.
